answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization aims to generate concise and informative texts from input documents.

answer_2.quote: ROUGE, BERTScore-Prediction, and FactKB are used to measure the quality and factual consistency, respectively. In addition, SacreBLEU is also introduced to evaluate the summaries.

answer_3.quote: We utilize GPT-4 to evaluate the quality and faithfulness of the generated summaries, which provides humanlike preference assessments compared to traditional evaluation metrics.
methods: ranking summaries based on quality and faithfulness jointly and separately
